AbilitiesResponse.description: Body of GET /api/v1/access/me/abilities: what the caller may do (the UI hides the rest).
AbilitiesResponse.title: AbilitiesResponse

AssetUpdate.description:
Only the fields sent change; ``syncVersion`` is the version the client last read.

``name`` may not be set to null; ``internalTag``, ``path`` and ``parentId`` are rejected
(extra=forbid), so a rename can never move a node or rewrite its identity.

``itemTypeId`` re-pins the asset to that type's current published version (``null`` clears the
type); ``attributes`` alone is validated against the version the asset is already pinned to.
AssetUpdate.title: AssetUpdate

AssignmentCreate.description: A team scope names no user (its members hold the role); every other scope needs userId.
AssignmentCreate.title: AssignmentCreate

AttributeDefinition.description:
One attribute's shape. Key pattern, field type and config are checked by the lint, so a
bad value comes back as a 422 ``ATTRIBUTES_INVALID`` issue with a path, not a schema error.
AttributeDefinition.title: AttributeDefinition

AuthErrorResponse.description: Body of a 401/403 on an authenticated route. Never names a tenant or a user.
AuthErrorResponse.title: AuthErrorResponse

EvaluateBody.description:
Answers to evaluate against a revision. ``complete`` and the rest of the result are computed
server-side and never accepted from the client (unknown keys → 422).
EvaluateBody.title: EvaluateBody

EvaluateContext.description: The evaluation context an expression may read as ``context.<key>`` (camelCase keys).
EvaluateContext.title: EvaluateContext

FileDownloadUrl.description: A short-lived presigned GET for a released (clean) file.
FileDownloadUrl.title: FileDownloadUrl

FormErrorBody.description:
A domain error: a stable ``code`` (``CODE_TAKEN``, ``TEMPLATE_INVALID``, ...) plus extras
such as the lint ``issues`` or a ``VERSION_CONFLICT`` ``current`` row.
FormErrorBody.title: FormErrorBody

HealthResponse.description: Body of GET /api/v1/health. Changing it changes the generated client (STACK-03).
HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse

InspectionCreate.description:
``POST /inspections``. Without ``templateRevisionId`` the template's current published
revision is pinned; with it, that published revision of ``templateId``.
InspectionCreate.title: InspectionCreate

InspectionDetail.description:
The record plus its workflow: ``currentState`` is the instance's (the truth), and
``instanceSyncVersion`` the value a transition may send as ``expectedSyncVersion``.
InspectionDetail.title: InspectionDetail

InspectionErrorBody.description:
A domain error: a stable ``code`` (``ASSET_NOT_FOUND``, ``NOT_COMPLETED``, ...) and the
term key of its message when there is one.
InspectionErrorBody.title: InspectionErrorBody

InspectionTransitionOut.description: 200 when the transition took effect, 202 when it waits for a countersign.
InspectionTransitionOut.title: InspectionTransitionOut

ItemTypeVersionOut.description: One version; ``compiledSchema`` is set once it is published.
ItemTypeVersionOut.title: ItemTypeVersionOut

JobOut.description: A job as the jobs API shows it. The payload stays server-side (it may hold record data).
JobOut.title: JobOut

JobPage.description: Newest first. ``next_cursor`` is the last item's id (job ids are UUIDv7, time-ordered).
JobPage.title: JobPage

JobStatus.description: Stable internal job status codes (labels come from terminology keys, never these).
JobStatus.title: JobStatus

LimitOut.description: ``limit`` null is unlimited; ``used`` null means nothing measures it yet.
LimitOut.title: LimitOut

LintFindingOut.description: One raw label found by the TERMS-07 scanner (lines and columns 1-based).
LintFindingOut.title: LintFindingOut

LoginStartResponse.description: Same status and keys whether or not the email or domain is known; never the tenant.
LoginStartResponse.title: LoginStartResponse

MeResponse.description: The caller's own user, tenant and memberships. Never another tenant's data.
MeResponse.title: MeResponse

ModuleInfo.description: A mounted module as reported by the registry.
ModuleInfo.title: ModuleInfo

OrganisationList.description: Every live organisation that matches, by name (a tenant has tens, not thousands).
OrganisationList.title: OrganisationList

OrganisationUpdate.description: Only the fields sent are changed; ``syncVersion`` is the version the client last read.
OrganisationUpdate.title: OrganisationUpdate

OverrideCreate.description: A boolean for ``feature.*``; a count, or null for unlimited, for ``limit.*``.
OverrideCreate.title: OverrideCreate

PlanAndUsage.description: The read-only "Plan and usage" page. No prices, invoices or payment data.
PlanAndUsage.title: PlanAndUsage

PresetOut.description: A ``config/workflows`` preset: its key, record type and neutral codes (no display text).
PresetOut.title: PresetOut

ProjectUpdate.description: Only the fields sent are changed; ``syncVersion`` is the version the client last read.
ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate

RenderJobView.description:
One render job. ``templateId``/``templateVersion`` are the pinned version, ``dataHash`` the
snapshot's; ``fileId``, ``pdfSha256`` and ``pdfSizeBytes`` are set once it has ``succeeded``.

REPORTS-04: ``recordLabel`` is the source record's label at request time (``None`` before
REPORTS-04), ``templateNameKey`` the pinned template's terminology key for its name. The PDF is
downloaded from ``GET /reports/renders/{id}/file``, never from a storage URL.
RenderJobView.title: RenderJobView

ReportErrorBody.description: A domain error: a stable ``code``; package errors add ``path`` and ``detail``.
ReportErrorBody.title: ReportErrorBody

ReportTemplateUpload.description:
A template package as JSON: ``template.json`` as ``definition``, the body, the stylesheet,
the sample data and ``assets`` mapping each declared asset name to its base64 bytes.
ReportTemplateUpload.title: ReportTemplateUpload

RevisionCreate.description: A new draft revision. ``schema`` omitted copies the current published schema.
RevisionCreate.title: RevisionCreate

RoleUpdate.description: Every field optional. A system role keeps its code and name (409 SYSTEM_ROLE_IMMUTABLE).
RoleUpdate.title: RoleUpdate

SessionOut.description: One of the caller's own live sessions (the "Active sessions" page).
SessionOut.title: SessionOut

SiteUpdate.description: Only the fields sent are changed.
SiteUpdate.title: SiteUpdate

StepUpErrorResponse.description: 401 from a critical action: confirm with a second factor at ``stepUpUrl``, then retry.
StepUpErrorResponse.title: StepUpErrorResponse

SubscriptionPut.description: An operator sets the subscription; ``contract_ref`` is required for production terms.
SubscriptionPut.title: SubscriptionPut

TeamUpdate.description: Every field optional; the project cannot change.
TeamUpdate.title: TeamUpdate

TenantErrorResponse.description: Body of a 401/403 from ``require_active_tenant``. Never names the tenant.
TenantErrorResponse.title: TenantErrorResponse

TenantView.description: The caller's tenant as other modules and the API see it.
TenantView.title: TenantView

TermsCoverage.description: Body of GET /api/v1/terms/coverage: the findings baked into the running build.
TermsCoverage.title: TermsCoverage

VersionResponse.description: Body of GET /api/v1/platform/version. Changing it changes the generated client.
VersionResponse.title: VersionResponse
